selection_reason: Publication explicitly says the contact line remains on the circular pad perimeter throughout this series.

sensitivity_mapping.name: literal_copper_rim
sensitivity_mapping.interpretation: A different physical approximation, not algebraically equivalent to the paper mapping.

negative_control_mapping.name: uncorrected_interface_gap
negative_control_mapping.interpretation: Intentionally inconsistent reference-plane mapping, retained to demonstrate its effect.

prior_default.interpretation: Fixed before this physical dataset was inspected; generic uncalibrated default, not an independently measured same-process value.

published_fit.interpretation: Fitted by the publication to every data point in Figures4-7. Calibration-dependent consistency only.

held_out.calibration: Use only unambiguous observations with applied shear <=81uN. Least-squares single multiplicative gamma from predicted shear at1N/m; intercept fixed0.
held_out.evaluation: Observations above81uN, including the144uN observation and both possible pairings at112uN. Never refit on evaluation rows.

observations: Experimental open-circle lateral offsets and cross-shaped heights only. Exclude simulation curves and small filled simulation nodes. Keep duplicate-load pairing ambiguity explicit.

uncertainty.digitization: Use the extraction record bounds from native figure pixels.
uncertainty.geometry: Use plotted h/x error-bar extents plus digitization. Their confidence level is not stated, so do not call them95percent intervals.
uncertainty.volume_sensitivity_reason: Approximately3*5um/255um from the paper's <=5um RMS ball-diameter variation. Sensitivity range only, not a joint confidence interval.
uncertainty.solidification: Evaluate a separate1.5percent increase of measured h and x, reflecting the paper's approximate liquid-to-solid linear contraction discussion. Do not treat it as a measured correction for each specimen.
uncertainty.normal_force: The explicitly reported1.95mN belongs to the cross-section set. Do not score Fig5 normal-force accuracy without its individual load provenance. Report model Fz only as a diagnostic.

acceptance.numerical: Every scored prediction must pass existing numerical checks; otherwise physical comparison is inconclusive.
acceptance.central_shear: Report each absolute and relative error, aggregate MAE/RMSE, and all outliers. No universal pass from a fitted mean.
acceptance.held_out: Report unambiguous held-out point errors and whether observed force intersects the prescribed geometry/volume sensitivity envelope. Duplicate-load conclusions must hold under both pairings.
acceptance.full_physical_validation: Not established if same-process gamma, individual specimen volumes or pairing information remain unidentified. A successful restricted consistency or held-out test does not establish general material/process accuracy.

design_comparison: Compare candidate circular pad/volume choices under the same explicitly prescribed gap, placement error and material scale. State the objective and simple analytic or current-design baseline. Require conclusion to survive a declared solder-volume sensitivity range. Do not predict free standoff, yield, or self-alignment time from this fixed-geometry model.
